A5 (menu) is finished and checked. A5 was already mostly built in earlier waves (menu.js, menu_items.js, menu_equip.js, menu_status.js, menu_book.js, menu_chronicle.js, menu_save.js, shop.js, gameover.js; menu_jobs.js is gone and kitStar now lives in menu.js). This session I re-checked it against DESIGN §11.7, fixed the bugs I found and added tools/check_menu.js, which compares the menu code against DESIGN/STYLE_JA. I screenshotted every menu screen at the 4× canvas and looked at each one. Results: test_menu 169 passed, 0 failed; check_menu 8 checks, 0 errors, 0 warnings; validate shows 0 errors for A5 (5 before); build --check exits 0.

Fixes this session:
- Game over could hang: if `R.GameOver.run()` was called outside Field's wipe flow, the respawn map's onEnter event closed the wake-up message and `run()` never finished. A guard now ends `run()` if the window is closed by someone else. The lead also made `UI.say` settle a superseded say.
- The bestiary's page 2 showed the raw race id `slime`. Added 軟体.
- Five STYLE_JA text errors in menu_save.js and shop.js (spacing, a line ending in ……, lines over 20 characters).
- The shop's gold window title was clipped at the top of the screen; the label now sits inside the window.

BRIEF over DESIGN (reported as required): BRIEF A6 line 374 says caster gear should be ranked by a total that also weighs 術力 (「術師向け装備は術力も考慮した総合点」). DESIGN §11.7.5's single formula `max(Δ攻,Δ術)+Δ守+floor(Δ術防/2)` can't put a 知力 hat above a 守備 helm for a mage, which DESIGN's own T4 test and screenshot #20 require. `Menu.candScore` therefore uses the DESIGN formula for fighters, the 術重視 weights for casters and their mean for balanced members. One more deviation: when neither 攻 nor 術 goes up, the smaller change counts, so a weaker weapon shows a loss instead of 0.

Design decisions:
- 技の書 / 術の書: ←→ first moves between the two columns and turns the tab only at the column edge. Otherwise the right-hand column could not be reached, since ↑↓ move by row.
- Inn: the morning line is split into two lines (「おはようございます。」 / 「いってらっしゃいませ。」) so it passes the 20-character check.

I reviewed A6 "newgame" independently and it matches the spec. I made one visual fix, in title.js, and nothing else needed changing. Tests pass: test_newgame 254/0 with the real modules and 254/0 with --stubs; check_newgame runs 1037 checks with 0 errors and 0 warnings.

How I checked:

The §5.4.4 counts over all 1140 trios hold (165 / 120 / 120 / 120 / 91.7%). A node probe found every item, tech and spell id that starterKit and the companions name in the live DB. The §6.1.3 rename to 急所ねらい is applied.
- Screens: I took and looked at 4× screenshots of every screen in debug_newgame.html. That covers the title (press-button stage, menu, 「新しい冒険を始めますか？」, and the slot picker with a real save) and all 5 creation steps: gender, type, favour for weapon+element and for mage with 組の属性, name entry on the カタカナ and 英数字 pages, and the confirm card. It also covers the choose-3 screen (both pages, number plates, 「この3人と旅立ちますか？」, join lines in pick order) and the tavern: commands, 仲間を探す with 「〜を仲間にするかい？」, and the 入れ替え screen.
- Behaviour: NameEntry.normalize/check handle full-width, half-width katakana, kanji, spaces, over-length and empty input. Tavern lines match §5.5.5, apart from two changes explained in the requests (a line break in one line, a longer overflow line).

Fixed: on the title's つづきから screen, the half-covered logo letters showed between the slot windows because the dimming layer was only 60% opaque. SlotPicker now draws an opaque night backdrop (#070818). I rebuilt and checked the screenshot.

BRIEF vs DESIGN: BRIEF Part A says names are 「五十音表から、4〜5文字」, while DESIGN §11.8.3 and §5.2.6 allow 1〜5. The code keeps 1〜5, because all 16 default おまかせ names in DESIGN §5.2.6 are 3–4 characters: a 4-character minimum would make 8 of them invalid. So 4〜5 must be the length cap, not a minimum. If the owner does mean a minimum of 4, only NameEntry.check changes.

Not A6's, seen while testing: region1_verda.js / region1_00_kit.js currently throw at load (「Script error.」 banner). Build.js still includes them because they have no syntax error.

A5.summary:
I reviewed A5 (menu) against DESIGN §11.7 / §0.7 A6-1…A6-6, STYLE_JA §8–§9 and BRIEF Part A2–A7, and read every file in the area. I took about 45 new screenshots at 4× (1024×896) and looked at each one: main menu (party healthy and with one member down), 道具 (3 tabs, gear filter), 技・術, detail popups (super-rare weapon, quirk accessory, rare accessory, key item, 格9 technique, consumable), 装備 (slot list, candidate list, Y popup, 最強装備 modes and confirm), 強さ, 並びと隊列, 技の書, 術の書 (三属 page), 図鑑 (list, page 1, page 2), 年代記, ワープ, セーブ, 設定, shop (buy, choosing a member, Y, sell), inn, 満タン, repeat item use, game over and the wake-up. The area is complete and matches the spec.

One real bug remained. When the game over runs outside Field's wipe flow, the wake-up lines 「{hero}たちは目を覚ました。」「所持金が半分になった。」 were never shown. The respawn map's onEnter event closed the window in the same frame, so the implementer's guard ended run() before anyone could see them. I confirmed this in the browser with a say/close log. The fix: the wake-up window can tell a window the player closed apart from one closed by someone else. If someone else closed or replaced it, the lines are shown once more after that event ends. I checked both paths in the browser: calling R.GameOver.run() directly and R.Field.gameOver(). In both, the lines show, and after A only FieldLayer remains, Events is not busy, input is on and there is no fade. My first version had a timing race on the Field path (the lines were shown twice); the check now uses resolveText, which fixes it.

Smaller fixes:
- The 付けると note now reads 「クセのあるアイテム（Yで詳細）」 instead of 「…品…」 (STYLE_JA §8: the screen word is アイテム).
- An accessory with no numbers shows 「―」 on popup row 2, as §11.7.18 specifies.
- The ワープ window is back to the specified (4,4,248,198) with 13 rows. The region name is narrowed to 70px so long names such as 「グレイモア湿原」 no longer run into the cursor.

BRIEF over DESIGN:
- BRIEF A6 (lead's reading) says the rarity marks are 通常 / レア★ / 超レア★★. DESIGN §11.7.18 and STYLE_JA say 超レア★. The popup's rarity label now reads 超レア★★. Item names keep the single ★ mark and their colours.
- I keep the implementer's candidate scoring, and their BRIEF-over-DESIGN reason still holds. Casters weigh 術力 (BRIEF A6 「術師向け装備は術力も考慮した総合点」), balanced members take the mean, and when neither 攻 nor 術 goes up the smaller change counts.

Deviations I left on purpose:
- The detail popup drops empty rows so short items get a shorter window.
- In 技の書 / 術の書, ←→ first moves between the two columns and only turns the tab at the column edge.
- Bestiary rows show 「001」 without 「No.」: the §11.7.9 widths don't add up with 「No.」.
- The 記録 cursor sits in the 4px gutter left of the window.
- The candidate columns are 4px left of the §11.7.5 x values to clear the frame.
- The shop's ▲▼ marks use the same candidate score. For someone with an empty 武器2 that can look large (it counts the gain of a second weapon).
